hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps between the V4 pool and Juicebox project terminals, selecting whichever venue gives the user more output tokens. Uses a 30-minute TWAP oracle to compare routes for buy-side (pay into project for tokens) and sell-side (cash out project tokens) swaps. Also serves as a TWAP oracle for external contracts via an IGeomeanOracle-compatible interface.
